# statuspage_metric (Data Source)

Fetches a Statuspage metric.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspage_metric" "example" {
  page_id = "abc123def456"
  id      = "xyz789"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `decimal_places` (Number)
- `display` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metric_identifier` (String)
- `metrics_provider_id` (String) The metrics provider this metric belongs to.
- `name` (String)
- `suffix` (String)
- `tooltip_description` (String)
- `y_axis_hidden` (Boolean)
- `y_axis_max` (Number)
- `y_axis_min` (Number)
